business_summary.text: Aegis Vopak Terminals operates liquid and gas storage terminals at JNPA, Haldia, Kandla, Pipavav, Kochi and Mangalore, providing terminaling services for petroleum products, LPG and ammonia.

operating_notes.text: Static Capacity for Gas Terminal Division reached 2,25,800 MT as of March 31, 2026.
Liquid terminals earn about INR 3,000 per CBM, which management calls a very good blended earning.
Gas throughput rose from 3.3 million tons in FY25 to 3.9 million tons in FY26.
JNPT Phase 1 liquid capacity of 318,000 cbm is expected to be mostly operational in H1 FY27.
LPG throughput charge is a standard ₹1,175 per metric ton, with principals paying up to ₹1,200, and is the same across all terminals.
JNPA liquid storage realisation is about ₹6,000 per cubic meter a year against a blended average of ₹3,000.
Ammonia terminal at Pipavav has 36,000 metric tons static capacity and can theoretically handle 1 million metric tons a year.
Aegis Energy Terminals Limited was incorporated as a 100% subsidiary on September 25, 2026.

timeline.summary: Aegis Vopak Terminals filed its Monitoring Agency Report for Q4 FY26 on May 4, 2026, reporting nil deviation in IPO proceeds utilization.
Aegis Vopak Terminals informed the exchange about an independently assigned ESG rating by NSE Sustainability Ratings & Analytics Ltd.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹243.45 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹68.64 Cr.
Aegis Vopak Terminals disclosed its Key Performance Indicators for the quarter and financial year ended March 31, 2026.
Aegis Vopak Terminals released its May 2026 investor presentation reporting FY26 revenue of ₹923.1 Cr and PAT of ₹341.9 Cr.
Aegis Vopak reported FY26 revenue of ₹923.1 Cr (+17% YoY) and net profit of ₹341.9 Cr (+52.1% YoY), and outlined a $5 billion capex roadmap through 2030.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹270.84 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹86.57 Cr.
Aegis Vopak Terminals Limited scheduled Q2 FY27 earnings call with analysts/investors on November 03, 2026, at 04:00 PM IST via Priyanka Vaidya.
